blocked.detail: The Go module cache is a tmpfs in every wrapper container (run_pinned.sh sets GOMODCACHE=/tmp/go/pkg/mod) and no cache is mounted; with --network=none `go list -m all` in IMG-GO cannot resolve any module (proxy.golang.org unreachable, evidence specs/001-full-project-audit-remediation/evidence/wp23/probes/go-offline.txt); a network fetch is not allowed here. The split-lane collector (T198) cannot run either: the compile-half lane rows (T121a) and verify_artifact.sh (T121b) are not built. The host has a populated module cache, but a host `go test` is a bare-host build, forbidden by constitution 11.4.173.

owed: a read-only module-cache mount in run_pinned.sh (an extension of the pinned runner, a WP-11 item) or an offline vendor/ tree; then T201 runs three times through the collector
